// diagnostic

E0119

`Bogus` isn't a known effect

What

`Bogus` isn't a known effect

Why

An effect list names compiler-known effects like `Net`, `FS`, `IO`, `DB`, or `Time`

Fix

use one of the known effect names, or remove it from the list

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0119: tests/ui/authority_not_dispatch.stderr.

Error [E0930]: `#FX` has no `Effect` called `Authority`
  --> tests/ui/authority_not_dispatch.jet:4:6
    |
  4 |     #FX(Authority) {
    |      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Effect` is a closed menu: `Net`, `FS`, `IO`, `DB`, `Time`, `Rand`, `Env`, `Exec`, `Log`, `GPU`, `FFI`, `Browser`, `Secret`
 Fix: pick one of `Net`, `FS`, `IO`, `DB`, `Time`, `Rand`, `Env`, `Exec`, `Log`, `GPU`, `FFI`, `Browser`, `Secret`
